name: pqsession-relay
description: Dumb relay for pqsession end-to-end sessions: forwards opaque ciphertext only; never sees keys or plaintext. v2: crash fix, backpressure, byte shaping, secure defaults, dynamic CSP hash, local vendoring of crypto libraries, optional native TLS.

scripts.test: node test-relay.mjs && node test-frontend.mjs && node test-e2e.mjs
